event_detail: Kettle: the gripper, with its fingers already closed on nothing, hovers above the kettle on the counter next to the stove for the whole 4.8 s, moving up and back down without grasping or lifting it.
evidence: Wrist camera shows the kettle sitting on the counter below the gripper in all four frames, never between the fingers; zooming on the finger pads shows them closed together (empty) in every frame. The shoulder views show the arm in nearly the same pose to the right of the stove throughout. The kettle is not on the stove and no burner is lit. The closed empty gripper suggests an earlier missed grasp.
